page_note: Heavily damaged page (80.6%). Theme: the primordial 'Approved one' (δόκιμος) — the first righteous one who became sinless before the aeons of Light, identified also as 'the first catechumen.' This identification of a primordial figure with the catechumenate is an ecclesial bridge — grounding the Manichaean lay institution in a cosmological prototype. First half is substrate cosmology (testing in aeons, First Man, five sons); second half pivots strongly to hortatory exhortation ('my brothers and members') and applies the prototype to the audience. Editorial fatigue score 0.58 confirms drift to hortatory in second half.
